stories.title: Federal appeals court upholds Pentagon's 'supply chain risk' designation of Anthropic
stories.reason: The 2-1 ruling keeps the US military barred from using Anthropic's models after talks collapsed over the Pentagon's demand for unrestricted access and Anthropic's refusal to let its technology be used for autonomous weapons or domestic mass surveillance, with Anthropic now weighing a Supreme Court appeal.

stories.title: Fiji declares a national emergency over a meth-fueled HIV epidemic, now affecting 1 in 60 adults
stories.reason: Cases have risen twelve-fold since 2010 to an estimated 9,000, driven by a post-COVID surge in injected crystal meth use among 20-to-34-year-olds, making it what public health specialists call the world's fastest-growing HIV epidemic.

stories.title: Anthropic's Claude autonomously discovers a novel CRISPR-like enzyme system in bacteriophages
stories.reason: In a 21.5-hour autonomous campaign spanning 949 agent sessions, Claude searched roughly 1.9 billion protein clusters and flagged a previously uncharacterized enzyme system -- dubbed ART -- whose repeat structure resembles CRISPR arrays, an early result from Anthropic's new life-sciences research lab.

stories.title: IDF suspends attack-drone use for 48 hours after an explosion kills two reservists in Gaza
stories.reason: The drone crashed and later detonated as soldiers approached it in northern Gaza, killing two reservists in an apparent malfunction that has paused drone operations pending a safety review, even as ceasefire violations continue nearly a year after the truce took effect.

stories.title: Senior IRGC commander killed in clashes with an armed group in southeastern Iran
stories.reason: Brigadier General Hossein Zarifi was killed in a raid on a suspected militant cell near Iran's border with Pakistan, a reminder that Tehran faces internal security threats in Sistan-Baluchestan even as it negotiates an end to its war with the US.

stories.title: BlackRock and IFM near a $20-25 billion deal for Stack's Asia-Pacific data centers
stories.reason: The BlackRock-backed AI Infrastructure Partnership, whose investors include Nvidia, xAI and Microsoft, is preparing due diligence on the portfolio, another sign of the enormous capital pouring into AI data-center infrastructure across Asia.

stories.title: Microsoft unveils an all-in-one Copilot app to challenge Anthropic and OpenAI in the workplace
stories.reason: The revamped app bundles coding and agent-building tools and moves to usage-based pricing, an attempt to boost adoption after fewer than 7% of Microsoft's 450 million commercial Office 365 seats have upgraded to its AI tier amid stronger enterprise traction for rivals.

stories.title: Qualcomm renews its global patent licensing agreement with Apple through 2027
stories.reason: The extension, effective April 2027, locks in continuity for iPhone modem supply even as Apple keeps developing its own in-house modem chips to eventually reduce its reliance on Qualcomm.
